title: Grusch's 'alternative timeline' view of the technology
place_text: Jesse Michels's interview with David Grusch

tellings.quote: he said if I were a betting man I think that this represents tech that is not a step-wise leap ahead of humanity but it's almost an alternative timeline in which they

plain: The technology behind UFOs is not just a step ahead of ours but looks like it comes from "an alternative timeline", according to a whistleblower named David Grusch. Michels says Grusch told him this in an interview in 2023, saying that "if I were a betting man" that is how he would read it. Michels repeats it himself, as Grusch's own guess about what the craft might be.
